stories.title: US proposed Donbas swap for NATO membership - Zelensky

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet in China next week

stories.title: China, US, Russia issue 'peace declaration' after summit
stories.why_it_matters: It is a rare joint statement from the three powers' leaders, issued while both the Ukraine war and the Iran situation remain unresolved.

stories.title: UK, EU launch reset with deals on food, youth mobility
stories.why_it_matters: It marks a formal reset in UK-EU relations by altering the post-Brexit terms between the two sides.
